newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria upgrades Computerland to buy.
newsitem.headline: IB Austria upgrades Computerland to buy.

text.p: Investmentbank Austria upgraded Polish computer systems supplier Computerland SA to buy from hold, saying its recent aquisition of one of the country's leading software firms promised a surge in next year's profits.

Under a September 30 agreement with CSBI, Poland's third-largest computer software company, ComputerLand will take over the company in exchange for a new share issue and an as yet undetermined cash sum.

"With increased capacity, the company is even better positioned to benefit from the expected growth in the Polish IT market. We have therefore revised our recommendation to a long-term buy," the Vienna-based Investmentbank Austria AG said in its November issue of central european equity overview.
Earlier IB Austria advised investors to hold ComputerLand shares.
